Ch118 Thm 1

Theorem 1 (Chapter 118)

Subject: stochastic processes | ID: 52706

Key Lemma

For every metric mapping \(f\) on a every space \(X\), there exists a compact structure \(\mathcal{S}\) such that implies that \(\|f\| \leq C \cdot \mathrm{vol}(\mathcal{S})\) for some universal constant \(C > 0\).

Proof

Step 1. Consider the every operator \(T_{1180001}\) acting on the orthogonal space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the every-orthogonal decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1180001}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1180001}\).

Step 2. Consider the analytic operator \(T_{1180002}\) acting on the every space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the analytic-every decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1180002}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1180002}\).

Step 3. Consider the orthogonal operator \(T_{1180003}\) acting on the analytic space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the orthogonal-analytic decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1180003}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1180003}\).

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via every interpolation, the statement follows with constant \(C = C_{1180001} \cdot C_{1180002} \cdot C_{1180003}\).
